istem: Our team is debating whether to move our Node 18 services to Node 22 before April. Our pinned dependencies are bcrypt 5.0.1, node-sass 7.0.3 and express 4.18.2. Tell me what is actually established about Node 18's end-of-life date and whether any of those pinned packages block Node 22. Nothing else, at most 12 lines.
